rules: One builder per lane. A lane edits only the paths in its `owns` list (tickets may name a path read-only).
smartsched/frontend/messages/{tr,en}.json are shared: add or change only keys of your own screens' namespaces; pull --no-rebase before every commit; never reorder or reformat the files.
Never touch `integrity_reserved` paths until the integrity agent (ledger integrity-r1) finishes and lists its files; lanes F and H have tickets that wait for that hand-over (depends_on).
Test first (vitest / pytest), then the ticket's check; report the commit per ticket so the round-2 testers re-verify.

tickets.title: With AI off, a Word file blocks the intake: 36 rows wait for 'AI' review and the review screen never appears
tickets.root_cause: (1) airows.py:45-52 is_ai() marks a record as AI-read when its file's format route is 'ai'. docx is registered with route 'ai' (formats_builtin.py:163-170), so the deterministic table rows read with AI disabled become pending 'ai' rows and a blocking ai_rows item. (2) lib/api/council.ts:90-95 REVIEW_KINDS has no 'ai_rows', so z.enum rejects the review payload. The review query fails, the generic 'Sunucuda bir sorun oluştu' toast fires with no failed request, and ReviewPanel never renders. Its KIND_LABEL (review-panel.tsx:25-34) also lacks ai_rows.
tickets.fix: is_ai() is true only for records the model produced (source.via == 'llm' or source.vision). Deterministic docx table rows are 'direct'. A docx with no readable table and AI off becomes a file-level warning 'YZ kapalı, okunmadı'. Add ai_rows to REVIEW_KINDS and KIND_LABEL. Unknown kinds fall back to a generic label instead of failing the schema. Add a contract test: every kind review.py emits parses in council.ts.
tickets.check: Fresh stack, AI policy off. Upload tests/fixtures/universal/rules_memo.docx alone in /onboarding: the İnceleme panel renders, and GET /council/jobs/<id>/rows counts method {direct: 36} with no 'ai'. No generic error toast. Then the full F-08 job (xlsx + csv + pdf + docx) reaches the commit panel. A vitest test: ReviewPanel renders a payload containing kind 'ai_rows'.

tickets.title: KVKK: instructor names travel to viewers in review item ids, and the intake memory keeps them after masking
tickets.root_cause: review.py:125 builds merge item ids as f"merge:{kind}:{a}|{b}" from the two person names. A VIEWER's review payload (content=false) still carries them. memory.py:158 stores "item": item_id in the remembered row, although the module promises 'never cell content or names' (memory.py:6). memory_admin.py:126-136 parses the names back out for 'Hatırlanan kararlar'. The memory row is not covered by masking or erasure.
tickets.fix: Make item ids opaque: a hash of the folded pair, like memory._merge_key (memory.py:69). The pair appears only inside `current`, and only when content=true. Memory stores only the hash key, with no item id. memory_admin resolves names only for planners, from the live job's dataset. Otherwise it shows 'Birleştirme (öğretim elemanı)'. Rows are name-free by construction, so no KVKK erasure change is needed (kvkk.py belongs to lane D).

After masking (README §4.4), /onboarding › Hatırlanan kararlar shows no full name. DB: no intake-memory row JSON contains an instructor display_name.

tickets.title: Timetable details: no start-week choice, 40 Tab stops before the grid, focus and count issues, and small phone targets
tickets.root_cause: move-dialog.tsx offers 'from <this week>' only, so 'from 23 Feb' needs week 4 on screen first. After 'Taşı', focus goes to the inspector, not the chip. The dative is wrong for names ('Test dersliği'ye'). The toolbar puts 40 Tab stops before the grid. Enter in the search keeps focus in the field. The overlay sidebar covers its own toggle and ignores Esc. 'Yerleşmeyenler (118)' versus 34 from the API. The sidebar shows the wrong term label. A soft split is shown in red as 'Çakışma'. Inspector history rows say 'Run #7'. On a phone: inspector 'Taşı…' 36 px, scope radios 22 px, free-room rows 30 px, and /classes chips 30 px. The week export file is named like the term file.
tickets.fix: A 'Başlangıç haftası' select in the move dialog. Focus the moved chip. Use tr_grammar dative for names. Add a skip link 'Izgaraya geç' (or `g t`). Enter focuses the first match. Esc and the toggle close the sidebar. One unplaced count from the API. Soft issues are not red. 'Çalıştırma #7'. 44 px rows and radios on touch. Name the file 'smartsched-run7-hafta4.xlsx'.
tickets.check: F-10 S01/S02 desktop+phone: from week 3, pick 'from week 4' and move → weeks 1–3 and 4–14 split. Focus is on the chip. From the top, ≤ 5 Tabs to the grid with the skip link. The sidebar count equals the API's unplaced count. M-02 on the move sheet and the inspector is clean.
tickets.dedup: see also R1-M-06 / R1-S-09 (integrity: forced move)

tickets.title: Undoing a wizard programme leaves its new courses, and the open button ignores the chosen mode
tickets.root_cause: The program draft undo in services/program_drafts.py archives the sections and people but not the courses it created ('Arşivlendi: 3 şube, 0 ders, 2 kişi'). GET /program-drafts/<id>/undo answers 409 on the generate step (a console error). With 'Yalnızca oluştur' chosen, the button still reads 'Oluştur ve çöz'.
tickets.fix: Track the courses the commit created and archive them on undo. Do not call undo before a commit. The button label follows the mode.
tickets.check: F-07 S08/S09: undo → 'Arşivlendi: 3 şube, 3 ders, 2 kişi', and GET /courses?code=… shows them archived. No 409 in the console. The 'Yalnızca oluştur' button reads 'Oluştur'.

lanes.done_when: every ticket's check passes; MOBILE M-02/M-03/M-05 at 390 on the lane's phone_routes; the lane's unit tests; no edits outside `owns` (ask the owning lane instead)
